spec: nice!nano v2, genuine (ZMK target nice_nano_v2)
notes: 4 needed + 1 spare. Bridge the BOOST jumper (500 mA charging, fine for cells over 500 mAh): about 2–3 h for 1000 mAh instead of about 12 h. Clones usually lack it. Measure USB-C height on arrival (sets case depth).

spec: Low-profile machined round-pin female header, 1×12, plus matching round male pins
india: Robu.in / Lamington Road: search "machined round female header 2.54"
import: AliExpress: "Mill-Max low profile socket pro micro"
notes: Controller sits hidden on the PCB underside; sockets make it swappable. 2 strips per controller.

spec: Kailh MX hotswap socket (CPG151101S11)
india: Already owned (100). Top-up: [StacksKB Gateron sockets](https://stackskb.com/store/gateron-hotswap-sockets/) fit the same footprint
notes: 100 covers keyboard 1 (66) with 34 spare. Keyboard 2 needs 66 more, so buy ~40 when you build it.

spec: 1N4148, through-hole DO-35
notes: 33 left + 34 right (encoder push switch is in the matrix). Cathode toward the row (COL2ROW).

spec: SK6812MINI-E (reverse mount, 3.2×2.8 mm)
india: Not stocked by Indian stores I checked
notes: 33 per-key per half, no underglow (the battery sits under the PCB). The only fiddly SMD part; buy plenty, joints fail. Alternative: JLCPCB assembles them.

spec: 10 µF + 100 nF capacitors, 0805 SMD (C1, C2)
notes: One of each near the first LED of each half's chain, on the nice!nano VCC rail.

spec: EC11 with push switch, 20 mm shaft
notes: Right half only. Check shaft type (knurled vs D) before buying the knob.

spec: Aluminium knob for 6 mm shaft, ~19 mm diameter
notes: Must match the encoder's shaft (knurled or D).

spec: 3.7 V LiPo pouch with protection circuit, ≤5 mm thick, 1000–1500 mAh (e.g. 503450, 5 × 34 × 50 mm), JST-PH 2.0 lead
import: Avoid: batteries rarely ship to India from abroad
notes: Lies flat over the hotswap sockets under the inner key columns, on a kapton sheet, at least 15 mm from the controller's antenna end. Up to 5 mm adds no case height. Check JST-PH polarity matches the PCB before plugging in.

spec: JST-PH 2-pin, side-entry through-hole (S2B-PH-K-S)
notes: Side entry so the battery lead runs flat under the PCB.

spec: AO3401A P-channel MOSFET, SOT-23 (Q101/Q201)
notes: Carries the battery current so the 50 mA slide switch only drives its gate. Source to the battery, drain to B+.

spec: 1 MΩ resistor, 0805 (R101/R201)
notes: Holds the MOSFET off between switch positions.

spec: USB-C 1-to-2 splitter cable (optional), to charge both halves from one charger
notes: Each half charges through its own USB-C; this just saves a second cable.

spec: MSK12C02 side-actuated SPDT slide switch (SMD, large pads)
notes: Side-actuated so it pokes out of the case edge; the same part most wireless split boards use. Hand-solderable.

spec: 6×6 mm tactile switch, through-hole, 5 mm tall (SW_PUSH_6mm_H5mm)
notes: On the underside next to the controller; press it through a pinhole in the case floor. ZMK can also enter the bootloader from a key.

spec: 2-layer FR4, 1.6 mm, HASL, 1 oz, left and right designs (each half ~17 × 13 cm)
india: [Lion Circuits](https://lioncircuits.com/) (Bengaluru, instant quote, 5–6 days, no customs)
price: from ₹799 for 5 (entry offer; quote for full size)
notes: Minimum 5 per design, so 5 left + 5 right. Check their DFM limits (6/6 mil on 1 oz) when routing.
